items.prompt: Edit this screenshot from our game The War Remains - a bright, stylised top-down 3D action game in a sunny painterly forest, game camera looking almost straight down. Keep the whole frame EXACTLY as it is: same camera, framing, terrain, grass, dirt path, rocks, tree shadows, lighting and colours. The hero (young man in a white tunic with a curved sword) and the monster(s) must stay identical - same pose, size, colours and brightness; do not redraw, whiten, relight, outline or add glow to any character. Do not add any new creatures, objects, text, icons or UI. Change ONLY the red enemy attack-warning marks on the ground (attack telegraphs). The frame has two warning marks. (1) A long straight rectangular charge lane: it starts under the mossy boulder-backed Stonehoof beast at the top-left and runs straight down to the bottom edge of the frame - the beast will charge along it. Timer state: the lane is filled from the beast down to the light band near the bottom (about 80% of its length); the last 20% is still empty. (2) A round root-trap circle on the ground to the right of the hero, half on the dirt path and half on grass (a Root Snarer's trap). Timer state: its fill has grown from the centre to about 65% of the radius. Keep both marks at exactly the same position, size and shape (the lane stays a straight rectangle, the circle stays a flat ellipse in this perspective), lying flat on the ground. Restyle both marks like this: STYLE E - diegetic forest magic, no painted UI. The border of each mark is traced by a dense line of tiny glowing warm amber-orange pollen / spore motes hovering just above the ground - so dense it reads as a clear, continuous glowing dotted edge. Inside the area the grass blades are pressed flat and bent, fallen leaves and petals pushed toward the border, the ground slightly shadowed and tinted warm orange-red, a few motes drifting inside. Lane: grass pressed flat along the lane, bent in the charge direction. Circle: grass swirled outward from the centre. Timer: the pressed, tinted, glowing area expands from the source (lane from the beast downward, circle from the centre outward) with a brighter band of motes at its front; beyond the front the grass is still upright and only the mote border is visible. Must still read instantly as a clear shape with a clear inside. No cracks, no blue, no purple. Output: the same screenshot with only the marks restyled.
